notes.title: Go to Hell!
notes.notes: [p]It's time to go to Hell, die, and wake up surrounded by beautiful ladies.[/p][p]Start your own business today in Devil Hearts, officially out of Early Access, released and completed.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun![/p][p][/p][p]P.S. The game will still receive updates for bug fixing so feel free to use the discussion board or join the discord to share your feedback. Thank you![/p]
